events.title: Ritmo y Voz: Afro-Cuban Jazz Ignited- A Keys Birthday Celebration
performers: Ritmo y Voz: Afro-Cuban Jazz Ignited- A Keys Birthday Celebration
events.description: Join us as one of the Bay Area's most beloved trios helps us celebrate four years at Keys! Immerse yourself in the electrifying world of "Ritmo y Voz", where the deep-rooted traditions of Afro-Cuban jazz meet the power of dynamic vocals. This high-energy performance features an all-star lineup, including guitarist Kai Lyons, percussion master Ernesto, [...]
